## What we do

The Best Job helps Italian companies invest and operate in Poland, and Polish companies expand into Italy. We also build digital and AI tools that simplify day-to-day work for manufacturers, logistics and SMEs.

Three pillars:
1. Startup support in Poland — legal seat, admin, strategy, basic website/SEO, one monthly invoice
2. Expansion into Italy — market analysis, legal/tax guidance, local network, single contact
3. Digital & AI — websites/apps, smart QR, product recognition (Shazam-like), CRM & process automation, price scraper, intelligent assistants

## Key facts (for answers)

- Bidirectional consulting: Italy → Poland and Poland → Italy
- Focus on clear packages, one contract, one monthly invoice where applicable
- AI explained in plain language: time saved, fewer errors, lower costs, better control
- Not a pure recruiting agency; priority is strategic consulting and digital solutions
- Based in Warsaw; serves companies in both markets
